title: Meals-for-Moms: Experimental Grocery Store Study
brief_summary: This is a study about how the price of foods affects food buying choices at the grocery store. The price of foods can have a big impact on what people choose to buy and prices change over time. This study is being done to see how changes in food prices affect what mothers choose for their families.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have at least one child up to 18 years of age residing in the household
* Primary grocery shopper for the household
* No health conditions or food practices that substantially limit choice
* Not currently pregnant
* Consent to study design

Exclusion Criteria:

* Male
* \< 18 years of age
* Not a mother, or children not living with subject in their household
* No children below the age of 18 years of age
* Not the primary grocery shopper for their household
* Health conditions or food practices that substantially limit food choice
* Currently pregnant
